notes.title: 1.3.11 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixes situations where in multiplayer mode, rush zones could force a restart.
[*] Fixes soft locks during arena fights.
[*] Fixes situations where the player could end up with a First person view instead of the standard top down view.
[*] Some Successes that were sometimes not possible to unlock can now properly be unlocked.
[*] Improved overall performances.
[*] Various major bugfixes.
[*] Minor bug fixes & quality improvements.
[/list]

tags.bug: - Fixes situations where in multiplayer mode, rush zones could force a restart.
